tags.name: What is Payment Object?
tags.description: Payment Object is an object that represents a payment transaction within Xfers system.

tags.name: What is Payment Method Object?
tags.description: Payment Method Object is an object that represents the method and the instruction to complete a payment transaction.

get.description: Get the status of your payment transaction by key in the payment ID from Xfers.

put.description:
List of actions to modify a given payment ID:
1.  **cancel** : Cancel a payment when it is still in pending state. Status will be changed to 'cancelled'. (Unique Amount only)
2.  **receive_payment** : Simulate Xfers receiving payment from the customer for a given contract id. Status will be changed to 'paid'. (Unique Amount and Sandbox only)
3.  **settle** : Simulate Xfers disbursing payment to the destination account. Status will be changed to 'completed'. (Sandbox only)

post.description:
With Unique Amount Bank Transfer payment method, you need pass us the amount that you want your customer to pay and we will give you the unique amount. 

 After your customer successfuly transfer with the unique amount, our system will associate it to your account and we will notify you with the successful callback.

RequestBody.description: This is the payment request with the amount and reference id.

BaseObject.description: This is the [payment object](./experiment#tag/What-is-Payment-Object) that Xfers already received.

status.description:
Payment status:
1.  **processing** : We have received the transaction and waiting for payment through the specified payment method to be carried out.
2.  **paid** : We have received the money via payment method channel.
3.  **completed** : We have disbursed the money to the destination account

expiration_time.description: Expiration time (ISO8601 format). maximum: 3 days after the request creation

Callback.description: This is the callback object that Xfers will return.

destination_account_id.description: This is the account ID that will be associated with the payment. You can get your account ID information via our [Get User Info API : /v3/user](../V3/Indonesia#operation/getUserInfo)

bank_type.description: Please specify the bank that you want your customer to transfer to. Listed under enum is our supported banks.

account_holder_name.description: The account holder name for the bank account that your customer will transfer to.

account_no.description: The account number for the bank account that your customer will transfer to.

unique_amount.description: The unique amount for your customer to transfer in order to complete the payment.
